messages:
troy_ops: FYI we just got an inbound alert from Kestrel: 18 units (mix of H100/H200) stuck at AMS crossdock due to a pallet label mismatch. Local handler asking for corrected manifest before release. This shipment contains 6 reserved for APAC capacity top-up and 5 for eu-central edge. Need contingency plan and RMA policy reminder.
vendor-kestrel: Apologies, label printer output truncated on one pallet. We have full serial manifest and corrected BOL ready. Agent requests re-acceptance fee waiver. AWB: KE-3347-AMS. We're ready to refile now.
troy_ops: Can we get ETA on clearance after refile? If it's >48h we should trigger fallback.
harry_fwd: Refile once we submit corrected manifest should clear in ~18-30h. If they ask for physical inspection add +12h. Courier suggests we can do an express refile for 
anya_fin: haha formatting broke. But financial ask: what's the expedite cost if we ask courier to prioritize? Also what is vendor liability for mis-labeling?
vendor-kestrel: We accept liability for mislabel and will cover local handling fees + courier expedite up to 
troy_ops: stop the weird nulls :facepalm: — vendor confirms they cover local fees and up to . (Note: system message munged currency). Lee_logistics elsewhere will reconcile actual quote.
nate_infra: Operational constraints: APAC pools expect 6 units by Mon 08:00 JST. If we miss that, we must reassign burst lane from dedicated pool in se-asia which will increase cost. I can prepare the reroute playbook: spin 3 loaner nodes from eu-central and colocate to tokyo region for 24-48h. Need approval for cross-border temporary transfer.
sophie_qa: QA flag: last batch had 1 unit with thermal sensor failure on arrival. RMA flow worked but caused 10h backlog. Can we pre-authorize vendor to accept DOA returns to vendor depot in NL and issue loaners immediately to avoid delay?
troy_ops: I'm inclined to pre-authorize as emergency measure for APAC-critical units only. We want vendor to confirm loaner firmware parity and logistics SLA.
vendor-kestrel: We can pre-authorize loaners for up to 5 units. Loaners will be same SKU family; we will stage firmware bundles and recovery scripts on the loaner USB image. RMA policy: DOA returns to vendor depot in AMS within 7 calendar days. We cover inbound RMA freight and expedite on our tab if error was our label.
anya_fin: If vendor covers expedite for label error, what's our remaining cost exposure? Estimate other indirect costs: transient dedicated credits, cross-region transfer fees, and potential SLA credits. We need a ballpark to sign off.
harry_fwd: Quick numbers: courier expedite is  for whole pallet; local handling waiver confirmed by vendor, so net estimate to us is < $1,500 assuming no inspection. If inspection required, add $900 and 8-12h. Slack calc only.
nate_infra: Contingency ops: 1) if ETA >30h, initiate cross-region loaner move (2 units) 2) mark 5 APAC reservations as pending and notify affected accounts 3) run warmup tests on loaners, takes ~25min.
sophie_qa: I'll prep a quick smoke test matrix and a config snippet for KV warmup: 
```
# KV warmup
for shard in [0,1]:
  prefetch(prefixes=top_100_prompts, parallel=4)
```
Run this after firmware validation.
troy_ops: Decision: vendor's covering local fees & loaners, courier expedite cheap -> proceed with refile + expedite. Nate, prep cross-region plan as standby. Sophie, have smoke test ready.
anya_fin: Approving up to $2k in incidental spend pending final invoice reconciliation.
ate_infra: On it. I'll spin transfer tickets and set a canary node in tokyo.
rma-bot: RMA ticket created: RMA-76214. Type: pre-authorized loaner. Vendor: vendor-kestrel. Owner: nate_infra.
troy_ops: Keep thread updated. Once manifest posted paste tracking and I'll close the loop. Also vendor please attach corrected manifest here.
vendor-kestrel: Corrected manifest uploaded: https://kestrel.example/ke3347/manifest.csv. Refile initiated at 4601234680, customs ETA 4601235440 optimistic.
troy_ops: Received. Marking APAC reservations as at-risk; starting canary. Closing for now, will reopen if inspection requested. :white_check_mark:
